Healthy Weight Range Calculator

Enter your height to see the weight range that corresponds to a BMI of 18.5 to 24.9. It is a broad screening range for adults, not a personal target.

Educational estimates only. Results are not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a treatment plan. Talk to a qualified healthcare professional about your health. Read the full medical disclaimer.

Adults only (18–120).

Example: 170

Height

How to use this calculator

  1. Enter your age (adults only).
  2. Choose metric or imperial units.
  3. Enter your height, then press Calculate.
  4. Read the range in kg and lb. Use Reset to start again.

The formulas

Height in metres = height in centimetres ÷ 100.

Lower weight = 18.5 × height (m)². Upper weight = 24.9 × height (m)².

Feet and inches are converted first: 1 inch = 2.54 cm. Pounds = kilograms ÷ 0.45359237.

What this range does and does not tell you

The range simply applies the standard adult BMI band to your height. People differ in frame, muscle, age and health, so a weight inside or outside the range does not by itself show good or poor health. Use it as a starting point for a conversation, not as a goal.

Want more detail? Read the guide: What BMI can and cannot tell you.

Frequently asked questions

Is this my ideal weight?

No. It shows the weights that fall in the adult BMI band of 18.5–24.9 for your height. It is a broad screening range, and no single weight is right for everyone.

Why does the range change with height?

BMI divides weight by height squared, so taller people have higher weights within the same BMI band.

Can I use this for a child or teenager?

No. Adult BMI bands are not valid for people under 18, who need age- and sex-specific growth charts from a healthcare professional.

What if I am outside the range?

Being outside the range is not a diagnosis. Muscle mass, body frame, age and medical conditions all matter. Please talk to a doctor or other qualified healthcare professional about your own situation.
